name: Vial of Spider Venom
summary: In Duskwood, spiders carry venom that Madame Eva needs for a protective ward. She gathers it with undead remains to make a Totem of Infliction.

sections.title: Duskwood's Venomous Threat
sections.body: Duskwood's thickets shelter venomous spiders, from pygmy venom webs and green recluses to black widows and Naraxis. Their fangs carry poison potent enough to paralyze travelers and decay flesh. Those who kill the spiders can draw the fluid into intact vials.

sections.title: Crafting the Totem of Infliction
sections.body: In Darkshire, fortune teller Madame Eva sees ominous portents for travelers setting out into the dark world. She needs five vials of spider venom, ghoul fangs, and skeleton fingers to craft a ward of retribution. Her craft turns the venom’s biting nature against attackers, making the Totem of Infliction return harm to anyone who strikes its bearer.

faq.q: Where does this spider venom come from?
aliases: where to get spider venom duskwood
faq.answer: The venom comes from predatory spiders in Duskwood, including Venom Web Spiders, Carrion Recluses, Green Recluses, Black Widow Hatchlings, and the monstrous broodmother Naraxis.

faq.q: Who wants Vials of Spider Venom?
faq.answer: Madame Eva, the seer in Darkshire, asks for five vials of spider venom, skeletal fingers, and ghoul fangs to make a magical ward.

faq.q: What is the venom used to craft?
faq.answer: Madame Eva combines the venom with undead remains to enchant a Totem of Infliction, a defensive talisman that magically harms attackers.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva need dangerous venom for a protective ward?
faq.answer: Madame Eva uses the deadly, retaliatory qualities of forest predators and the undead to make a charm that turns violence back on the aggressor.

angles.text: As a rogue, you may brew poisons and coat blades, but this raw spider venom is meant for mystic shielding rather than direct assassination.
As an Alliance adventurer on Duskwood’s shadowed roads, you can help Madame Eva make protective totems for travelers facing the woods’ horrors.
